reason: Above the range of the Android Legacy UI (API 9 to 23, owner decision): this platform is served by the Modern UI (verdict android-7.0-x86_64-modern.json) and no Legacy deliverable record names it. For the record, on 2026-11-15 the Legacy APK (renamed to the package id fr.bansan.loomora.probe) was installed on this emulator to prove the rename and its 15 reference vectors passed (the x86 library ran as a 32-bit process, so its probe lines read platform_id android-7.0-x86); that run is not stored as evidence because it proves nothing about the Legacy range. Rerun on 2026-11-15 on the APK rebuilt by tools/build.py (sha256 7eb8d186..., AVD API24, headless, port 5556): python tools/run_vectors.py android-7.0-x86_64 legacy --ui-abi x86 passed 15 of 15 vectors (16 skipped, 46.7 s); without --ui-abi it fails 15 of 15 on platform_id alone (android-7.0-x86, expected android-7.0-x86_64), which is the intended behaviour: the launcher takes --ui-abi (see validation/procedures/android.md, part C) to say that this device runs the UI as a 32-bit x86 process, and it refuses any ABI that is not a 32-bit companion of the device's. SPEC 002 (2026-11-17, recorded 2026-11-18): the same Legacy UI (APK of 2026-11-17, x86 library as a 32-bit process, --ui-abi x86) also matched `loomora validate --quiet` in 37 of 37 project-mode runs and passed 15 reference vectors on this emulator (AVD API24, 15 passed, 16 skipped, 42.6 s); the results are in android-7.0-x86_64-modern.json and android-4.1.2-x86-legacy.json. They prove nothing about the Legacy range (API 9 to 23, this platform is above it), so the verdict stays not_tested.
